title: Phase 5 (SRS.md + UML) -> scrum-master-agent (Phase 6) handoff
description: Encodes the INPUT/OUTPUT contract in docs/orchestration/02-architecture-workflow.md, section 'INTERFACE CONTRACTS', block 3. traces_to_fr validates structural presence of an FR reference (pattern match), not that the referenced FR exists in SRS.md -- referential integrity across documents is out of scope for this schema. Full FR-coverage completeness (every input.srs_fr_list entry covered by >=1 story) and circular depends_on detection are out of JSON-Schema's expressive power (they need cross-array/graph logic) and are checked instead by the companion script docs/orchestration/schemas/validate_handoff.py, not silently unchecked.

uml_diagrams.description: The 7 essential diagrams per docs/orchestration/02-architecture-workflow.md's Phase 5 diagram scope note

stories.description: Keyed by story_id (moved from a separate property into the object key itself, matching the endpoints design in hld-to-api-spec.schema.json) so no two stories can share an ID -- object keys are unique by construction. Still deliberately named generically as 'stories', not 'sprint_1_stories', since this schema covers every sprint, not just Sprint 1; this further diverges from backlog_draft.json's literal array shape, intentionally, for native story_id uniqueness enforcement.

traces_to_fr.description: Required, pattern-constrained FR traceability -- the machine-enforced 'no story without an FR' guarantee. FR-coverage completeness (every FR in srs_fr_list mapped to >=1 story) is checked by validate_handoff.py, not this schema.

text.description: minLength is a triviality guard (rejects placeholder text like 'ok'), not a true semantic-quality check.

depends_on.description: Circular-dependency detection (Kahn's-algorithm cycle check over story_id -> depends_on) is out of JSON-Schema's expressive power and is checked by validate_handoff.py, not this schema.

assumes.const: every FR in SRS.md is implementable within the approved HLD

must_not.const: introduce stories with no FR traceability
